dialogues.speaker: Oath Lantern
dialogues.text: (The metal shade of this standard lantern is covered in tiny scratches, and a line of text is carved around its base.)

dialogues.speaker: Oath Lantern
dialogues.text: "We are the Lightkeepers, who shine the eternal light of hope into the endless snow-swept plains."

dialogues.speaker: Oath Lantern
dialogues.text: (On one side of the lantern's shade, there is a hidden compartment. Inside it is a yellowed note.)

dialogues.speaker: Oath Lantern
dialogues.text: A dim lantern. It appears to be the signature equipment of a <color=#00E1FFFF>Lightkeeper</color>.
